title: Full production three-component gradient-flow well-posedness
statement: For the canonical P1 variational functional on a fixed three-torus at the pinned production parameters and eta_shell=0, the full linear operator on the real Hilbert space L2(T3;C3) is self-adjoint on H4, bounded below by the positive shell mass, and coercive in H2. The family and lock matrices are positive semidefinite, the Class-II J-K coefficient matrix is positive definite, and the positive sextic term absorbs the negative quartic term. These close the algebraic/coercive baseline. A complete H2 local-to-global well-posedness argument is assembled as a proof candidate, pending the three named analytic audits.
scope: T4 FULL-PROOF-CANDIDATE: Psi in C3 on the fixed periodic cell; real L2 pairing; the hash-pinned A1 reference functional; production coefficients including positive rho and Class-II mass regularisers; eta_shell exactly zero. The theorem target is unique global H2 solutions, continuous H2 dependence, energy decrease, and C-infinity smoothing for t>0. The historical external backend and nonzero shell-bias continuum limits are excluded.
falsifier: A non-Hermitian production linear term, nonpositive linear H2 lower bound, indefinite Class-II coefficient matrix, loss of the positive regulariser or sextic coefficient, failure of the H2-to-L2 local-Lipschitz estimate for the full Euler-Lagrange map, failure of the energy identity/continuation argument, or a finite-time blow-up/non-uniqueness example in the stated H2 scope.
no_overclaim: T4 is a proof candidate, not a T6 theorem. No claim is made for the historical non-variational backend, eta_shell nonzero, Hs initial data below H2, R3/infinite volume, the mu2<0 branch, minimizer uniqueness, BCC selection, stability, T6, or T7.
